ideas.title: Made for iPhone Duo
ideas.body: Open, Today is laid out like an iPad, on one wide screen: your next dose beside your journey, with one-tap logging underneath. Stood half open on a table, your next dose, goal and water are on the top half and Log Injection and Quick Log on the bottom. Closed, the outer screen works like any iPhone.

ideas.title: Log a dose with your iPhone Duo half open
ideas.body: Record Injection on a half-open Duo shows where you've injected before on the top half, and the buttons for each site on the bottom.

ideas.title: Progress photos with the Duo's main camera
ideas.body: With the Duo open, the outer screen shows you the picture, your last photo of the pose to line up with, and the self-timer counting down.

ideas.title: Quick Log
ideas.body: A row of one-tap buttons on Today: a glass of water or a serving of protein (Premium) is added straight away, with Undo, and your weight or today's check-in is a tap away.

ideas.title: Log Injection on Next Dose
ideas.body: Next Dose always has Log Injection, and shows where and when you injected last time.

ideas.title: Record Injection on one screen
ideas.body: Choose where you injected, then Save. Everything fits on one screen.

ideas.title: Your Journey on Today
ideas.body: How your weight has moved, with each dose marked, right on Today, with Goal and Water side by side.

ideas.title: iPad: Today on one screen
ideas.body: In landscape, Today shows it all at once: Next Dose beside Your Journey, Quick Log, your goal, water and week, when each injection site was last used, and your recent entries.

ideas.title: A new camera for progress photos
ideas.body: A self-timer, flash and an outline to step into, so each photo lines up with the last.

ideas.title: 3D injection body map
ideas.body: The body map (Premium) as a 3D figure you can turn, showing only the areas your medicine's manufacturer lists and where you've injected before. The flat map is still there if you prefer it.

ideas.title: A shorter welcome
ideas.body: Getting started takes four steps, and Premium shows its plans first.

ideas.title: Widgets for StandBy
ideas.body: Next Dose and Water widgets made for StandBy.
